description: Change a saved chart. Pass only what changes: the name, the description, display_settings (replaced as a whole), the period, the metric or the chart type; the rest stays as saved. series replaces all series; common_conditions and user_conditions need series in the same call (take them from analytics_chart_get). Dashboards with the chart show the change at once

app_project_id.description: The analytics app project ID from analytics_projects_list. Events are counted only in this project

chart_variant.description: LINES_CHART: trend over time. BARS: bars per period, or one total bar per series with display bars_mode TOTAL (good for "which channel / page / device is the biggest"). FUNNEL: conversion through ordered steps (series = steps, 2 to 20). RETENTION: how many users come back (exactly 2 series: the start event, then the return event)

common_conditions.description: Conditions added to every series, e.g. to drop test traffic: location_origin NOT_CONTAINS ["localhost","127.0.0.1"]. Stored inside every series, so analytics_chart_get shows them in each series

condition.description: Comparison, EQUAL by default. NOT_EQUAL and NOT_CONTAINS keep events that do not have the property at all

param_values.description: Values to compare with. EQUAL and CONTAINS match any of the values, NOT_EQUAL and NOT_CONTAINS match none of them, GREATER_THAN and LESS_THAN use the first value as a number, IS_SET and IS_NOT_SET ignore the values (pass [])

compare_previous_period.description: LINES_CHART and BARS: also count the same number of periods right before the range to compare with

display_settings.description: How the chart is drawn on the page. Does not change the numbers

bars_mode.description: BARS only: GROUPED bars side by side, STACKED bars on top of each other, TOTAL one bar per series for the whole range (labels are cut to 16 characters)

formulas.description: Up to 5 calculated series from two series, e.g. conversion = DIVIDE(buyers, visitors). Shown only when both series have data

operator.description: DIVIDE shows A / B in percent

series_a.description: Series name A from the preview result

series_b.description: Series name B from the preview result

title.description: Label of the calculated series, e.g. "Конверсия, %"

series_settings.description: Renames or colors of series, mostly for breakdown values like "Канал (search)" -> "Поиск". Not used by FUNNEL: name the steps with series[].title

series_name.description: Series name from the preview result (series[].name), e.g. "Канал (search)"

title.description: New label shown instead of the series name

value_mode.description: LINES_CHART and BARS: values as is, running total, or moving average

funnel_conversion_window_seconds.description: FUNNEL only: all steps must be done within this time from the first step, e.g. 86400 = 1 day, 604800 = 7 days. Not limited when not set

metric.description: UNIQ_USERS (default): unique users per period. TOTAL_EVENTS: number of events per period. FUNNEL and RETENTION always count users

period.description: Time range of the chart. Prefer a live period (last_periods_count) so the chart stays up to date on a dashboard

from_time.description: Fixed period start, ISO 8601 with a timezone. Use only when the user asks for exact dates; needs to_time too. The chart then never moves

last_periods_count.description: Live period: the last N periods including the current one, the chart moves with time. "Last 30 days" = DAILY + 30, "last 12 weeks" = WEEKLY + 12, "last 6 months" = MONTHLY + 6. Default 30 when from_time is not given

time_scale.description: One point (or bar) per hour, day, week or month

to_time.description: Fixed period end, ISO 8601 with a timezone, used together with from_time

retention_periods_count.description: RETENTION only: how many periods after the start period to track returns (DAILY up to 30, WEEKLY up to 26, MONTHLY up to 12). Cohorts are the periods of `period`: keep it up to 90 days, 52 weeks or 24 months

series.description: Series of the chart in order. FUNNEL: steps from the first to the last. RETENTION: [start event, return event]. The same event type may be used several times with different conditions

breakdown_property_key.description: LINES_CHART and BARS only: split this series by the values of an event property (key from analytics_event_properties_list), e.g. "traffic_channel", "utm_source", "device_type". Each value becomes its own series; rare values are joined into an "other" series

conditions.description: Conditions on event properties of this series only, all must match. Example: page_path EQUAL ["/pricing"] to count only views of the pricing page

condition.description: Comparison, EQUAL by default. NOT_EQUAL and NOT_CONTAINS keep events that do not have the property at all

param_values.description: Values to compare with. EQUAL and CONTAINS match any of the values, NOT_EQUAL and NOT_CONTAINS match none of them, GREATER_THAN and LESS_THAN use the first value as a number, IS_SET and IS_NOT_SET ignore the values (pass [])

title.description: Series label shown on the chart and in the legend, e.g. "Посетители" or "Оплатили". For a FUNNEL it is the step name. With breakdown_property_key the series names become "<title> (<value>)"

timezone_offset_minutes.description: Timezone of day boundaries, minutes east of UTC: Moscow 180, Kaliningrad 120, UTC 0. UTC when not set

user_conditions.description: Conditions on user properties for the whole chart, e.g. email NOT_EQUAL ["me@example.com"] to hide the team

condition.description: Comparison, EQUAL by default. NOT_EQUAL and NOT_CONTAINS keep events that do not have the property at all

param_values.description: Values to compare with. EQUAL and CONTAINS match any of the values, NOT_EQUAL and NOT_CONTAINS match none of them, GREATER_THAN and LESS_THAN use the first value as a number, IS_SET and IS_NOT_SET ignore the values (pass [])

name: analytics_chart_update
